# Setup
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

knitr::opts_chunk$set(dpi = 300, collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(glue)

basedir <- here("species/scla/bulk/PIG022/refseq_v1")
resdir <- here(basedir, "results/04b_L1-normalization")
fs::dir_create(resdir)
```

# Data

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

samples_all <- read_csv(here(basedir, "data/samples_clean.csv"))
tpm_all <- read_csv(here(basedir, "data/03_compiled/tpm_clean.csv"))

tpm_all_long <- tpm_all |>
  pivot_longer(cols = -gene_id, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "tpm") |>
  left_join(samples_all, by = "sample_id") |>
  mutate(sample = fct(sample, c("S", "I1", "I2", "I3", "I4", "I5", "I6")))

```


# Identify stomach contamination genes in I1

The S-I1 dissection boundary is imprecise, so highly expressed S genes can
show leakage into I1. After excluding S and L1-normalizing across I segments,
these genes appear I1-enriched. We identify them using L1 normalization across
all 7 segments: contaminating genes have USS_S close to 1 and USS_I1 >> USS_I2-I6.

```{r}
l1_normalize <- function(x) {
  x / sum(abs(x))
}

tpm_thresh <- 5
```

```{r}
# Expression filter (all 7 segments)
# in every replicate to prevent undefined USS from all-zero replicates
expressed_genes_7seg <- tpm_all_long |>
  summarize(max_tpm = max(tpm), .by = c(gene_id, rep)) |>
  summarize(all_over_thresh = all(max_tpm > tpm_thresh), .by = gene_id) |>
  filter(all_over_thresh) |>
  pull(gene_id)
```

## L1 normalize across all 7 segments

```{r}
uss_7seg <- tpm_all_long |>
  filter(gene_id %in% expressed_genes_7seg) |>
  mutate(uss = l1_normalize(tpm), .by = c(gene_id, rep))
```

## Flag S-contamination genes

```{r}
uss_S_thresh <- 0.75

median_uss_by_segment <- uss_7seg |>
  summarize(median_uss = median(uss), .by = c(gene_id, sample))

stm_spillover_genes <- median_uss_by_segment |>
  filter(sample == "S") |>
  filter(median_uss > uss_S_thresh) |>
  pull(gene_id)

length(stm_spillover_genes)
```

## Diagnostic plots

```{r}
#| fig-height: 7
#| fig-width: 4
#| out-width: "60%"

median_uss_by_segment |>
  ggplot(aes(median_uss)) +
  geom_histogram(color = "white", binwidth = 0.02) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(sample)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```


```{r}
#| fig-width: 4
#| fig-height: 3
#| out-width: "60%"

median_uss_by_segment |>
  filter(gene_id %in% stm_spillover_genes) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = sample, y = median_uss, group = gene_id)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.15) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

## Save flagged gene list

```{r}
median_uss_by_segment |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = sample,
    values_from = median_uss
  ) |>
  filter(gene_id %in% stm_spillover_genes) |>
  arrange(desc(S)) |>
  relocate(S, .after = gene_id) |>
  write_csv(here(resdir, "stm-spillover-genes.csv"))
```

# L1 normalization (intestine only)

Since all TPM values are positive, L1 normalization in this case is identical to unit sum scaling.

```{r}
tpm_long <- tpm_all_long |>
  filter(sample != "S") |>
  mutate(sample = fct_drop(sample))
```

## Remove lowly expressed genes and stomach spillover genes

```{r}
# expressed over threshold in at least one sample in all replicates
expressed_genes <- tpm_long |>
  summarize(max_tpm = max(tpm), .by = c(gene_id, rep)) |>
  summarize(all_over_thresh = all(max_tpm > tpm_thresh), .by = gene_id) |>
  filter(all_over_thresh) |>
  pull(gene_id)
```


```{r}
tpm_long <- tpm_long |>
  filter(!gene_id %in% stm_spillover_genes) |>
  filter(gene_id %in% expressed_genes)

n_distinct(tpm_long$gene_id)
```

## Normalization

```{r}
uss_long <- tpm_long |>
  mutate(uss = l1_normalize(tpm), .by = c(gene_id, rep))

stopifnot(
  "USS values do not sum to 1 for all gene_id/rep groups" = uss_long |>
    summarize(sum_uss = sum(uss), .by = c(gene_id, rep)) |>
    pull(sum_uss) |>
    near(1) |>
    all()
)
```

# Save data

```{r}
uss_wide <- uss_long |>
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = gene_id,
    names_from = c("sample", "rep"),
    names_sep = "_",
    values_from = "uss"
  )

if (any(uss_wide$gene_id %in% stm_spillover_genes)) {
  stop("Some stomach spillover genes are still present in the data!")
}

write_csv(uss_wide, here(basedir, "data/03_compiled/uss_intestine.csv"))
```
